name: Default Consultative Framework

stage_model.name: Connect
stage_model.goal: Disarm resistance, make it a real conversation, focus on them.

stage_model.name: Discover
stage_model.goal: Gather the facts of their present situation.

stage_model.name: Frame the Problem
stage_model.goal: Surface the problem, its cause, and how it's affecting them.

stage_model.name: Consequence
stage_model.goal: Get them to picture what happens if nothing changes — build urgency.

stage_model.name: Qualify
stage_model.goal: Confirm how important solving it is to them.

stage_model.name: Transition
stage_model.goal: Bridge from discovery to showing the solution.

stage_model.name: Present
stage_model.goal: Show how the solution solves THEIR stated problem — only after discovery.

stage_model.name: Commit
stage_model.goal: Help them commit and name the next step.

note: De-branded stage model + alert-fatigue gating defaults synthesized from internal realtime cue research. The 23 cue definitions + 8 scheduled goals load separately into cue_definitions/cue_goals (a later slice); this file seeds the framework header only.
